basic_info.description: Perched on Russian Hill at 858 Green Street, this charming condo features two bedrooms and one bathroom, offering the perfect blend of comfort and city living. Enjoy breathtaking views of iconic landmarks, including Alcatraz, the bay, and the Skystar attraction at Pier 39. Nestled in a peaceful neighborhood, this home provides a serene retreat while maintaining a central location with easy access to northern San Francisco. Just a short walk from North Beach and Chinatown, you'll have an abundance of dining, shopping, and entertainment options at your doorstep. Additional highlights include newer appliances, an updated gas fireplace, and a prime location that seamlessly combines convenience and tranquility. Make this exceptional property your new home!
